- [ ] 新功能 / New feature

## 变更描述 / Description
简洁地描述这个 PR 做了什么。
Briefly describe what this PR does.

## 相关 Issue / Related Issue
- Closes #(issue number)

## 测试 / Testing

- [ ] 已验证签名 `codesign --verify --deep --strict build/MacAppFixer.app`
- [ ] 已手动测试 / Manually tested

添加截图说明变更。
Add screenshots to illustrate the change.

## 检查清单 / Checklist
- [ ] 代码遵循项目规范 / Code follows the project conventions
- [ ] 已添加必要的文档 / Necessary docs added
- [ ] 新增或修改的文案已同步到 `en.lproj` 与 `zh-Hans.lproj` / New or changed UI strings are added to both `en.lproj` and `zh-Hans.lproj`
- [ ] 构建与校验全部通过 / Build and checks pass
